fields.description: Public write-only ingest key. Browsers send it in the request body; server-to-server callers in the X-Pulse-API-Key header.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Max ingest requests per minute, per site (default 60)
fields.label: Rate Limit

fields.description: Direct stores events in the database during the ingest request. Redis Stream is the legacy path, kept for rollback.
fields.label: Ingest Mode

fields.description: Server-managed rotating salt for cookieless anonymous ids. Rotates every UTC day; the previous value is overwritten and not recoverable. Do not edit.
fields.label: Anonymous Salt

fields.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) the current Anonymous Salt was generated for.
fields.label: Anonymous Salt Day
